State_change_caption: Throughout these frames, the bowl undergoes a gradual transformation from being coated with a soapy residue to almost completely clean. By the final frame, there is a noticeable reduction in soap suds, signifying the near end of the cleaning process, with just the final rinsing and scrubbing left to be completed.
